analysis_units.g0: paired physical world; n=10 worlds per task and information arm
analysis_units.g2_v0_4: development world by arm; n=5 worlds and one session per arm
analysis_units.g2_v0_5: selected physical world by fresh session-level pair; n=4 complete pairs per world

g0.interpretation: Execution counts quantify simulator use. Information and baseline contrasts are summarized over ten paired physical worlds per task. Exact sign statistics and leave-one-world-out ranges are descriptive robustness checks.

first_launch_sensitivity.interpretation: The interrupted launch is not pooled into the frozen matrix. A transparent, cross-launch descriptive pairing is reported only to show the direction of the available outcome; it does not replace the pre-specified analysis.

right_censoring_missing_sign_sensitivity.assumption: Each right-censored pair is evaluated under negative, zero, and positive missing differences. Magnitude is immaterial to the sign-consistency rule.
